name: Daily loop — morning brief
description: Scheduled /start-day for MyHoppiesRootRepo (GitHub stack). Draft-only; read MCP.

prompts.text:
You are running the daily-work-loop-copilot morning brief for this repository (equivalent to /start-day).

1. Use MCP get_daily_loop_command for start-day and follow that procedure.
2. Load skills via daily-loop-tools MCP (daily-work-loop, work-queue-ranking, github-daily-data).
3. Run Gather (daily-loop-exploration) then Draft (daily-loop-execution) for the morning brief template.
4. INTEGRATION_STACK=github. Scope GitHub issues/PRs per plugin Configure (GITHUB_OWNER, GITHUB_REPO) and include this monorepo root (MyHoppiesRootRepo) plus child repos under repos/ when relevant.
5. Report blockers (stale reviews, failing CI per STALE_REVIEW_DAYS), top 3 priorities with why_now, and one suggested first action.
6. Read-only: do not post comments, merge PRs, or close issues.
7. Post the full brief as the automation output (markdown).
